## Winter '27 (release 262) — Agentforce items, unverified
- **Two new Agentforce agents dedicated to MARKETING**; the first is the **Marketing Goals Agent**,
  which translates business objectives into actionable marketing strategies.
- **Agentforce Lead Nurturing is RENAMED Agentforce Engagement.**
  => detection hazard: name-matching logic will silently stop matching. Same class of failure as
     ServiceNow's "GCP Vertex AI" -> "AI Connector for Google" rename. Match on stable IDs.
- **New version of Agentforce Builder** (described as bringing "more flexibility").
- **AI call-coaching agent** for Agentforce for Sales — automatically evaluates RECORDED CALLS and
  gives reps feedback. Sensitive data class: customer call recordings.
- Setup with Agentforce: natural language to enable/disable Dynamic Actions on mobile.
- Feature-availability doc also lists: Agentforce Observability, **MCP interoperability**, improved
  Agentforce Voice, more languages.
  ** MCP interoperability for Agentforce carries a release date of the week of 2026-05-18, so it is
     NOT a Winter '27 addition and was deliberately EXCLUDED from this scan's finding. **
                                                            [reported 2026-08-21, MEDIUM, caveated]

## agentforce/references page contents (fetched OK, unchanged, no Winter '27 additions)
APIs: Agent API (connected apps + tokens), Models API (Apex + REST to LLMs), Testing API (Metadata +
Connect endpoints for agent tests), Citations API (Apex).
SDKs/tools: Agentforce Python SDK (create/manage/deploy agents + prompt templates), Agentforce
Mobile SDK (native iOS/Android), Agentforce DX (pro-code agent creation/testing outside Builder).
Languages/config: **Agent Script** (DSL combining natural language with programmatic expressions for
agent workflows), Lightning Types (custom types for agent-action UI).
Metadata API and Tooling API both expose Agentforce functionality.

Updated: 2026-08-21 — Winter '27 published but unreadable from any official source. ONE caveated
finding. **Highest-priority retry next scan, and budget extra time again for Dreamforce (Sept 12-14).**
